newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury to switch to new incentive scheme.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury to switch to new incentive scheme.

text.p: Cadbury Schweppes Plc said on Wednesday it is switching the criteria used for its long term incentive plan for management to emphasise shareholder value.

Chief executive John Sunderland said the group was in the process of trying to align management's interests more closely with shareholders by switching to an incentive plan based on total shareholder return, which links performance to dividend growth and share price performance.
"It's my intention to ensure our commitment to shareholder value is management incentivised," he said.

Chairman Dominic Cadbury, speaking at a news conference on Cadbury's annual results, said, "We have for quite a long time now perhaps rather exclusively focused on earnings per share as our criterion by which we judge ourselves and we're saying there is a more appropriate measure."

He said Cadbury was switching the criteria to total shareholder return which seemed to do the job more comprehensively. The company's remuneration committee has already agreed the change, but it still requires shareholder approval.
